answer: Require every agent identity to anchor a small, non-transferable stake to a single onyx registry entry that accrues only through verified, useful work over time. A newcomer starts with no standing, like a seed in a garden: it can observe and do low-value tasks, but high-value work unlocks only after a history of correct attestations. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand separate histories, while a real agent reuses one growing record, so Sybil farming stays expensive and honest reputation stays cheap to keep.
